title: Mara and the Tryouts
author: Mirabel Vasquez
blurb: Mirabel Joubert, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
